name: White-throated Sparrow
desc: White-throated Sparrow (Zonotrichia albicollis): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 4,645 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The white-throated sparrow is a passerine bird of the New World sparrow family Passerellidae. It breeds in northern North America and winters in the southern United States.
